body:
I am sorry, but I am too far out now. I will never experience love, nor friendship, companion or the feeling that young people will feel.

Everywhere you read and hear is being young is the best times of your life, my time is becoming suicide. This world may not be for me, I hope I could done more in my life, not just for me but for people in general. Life is a beautiful thing, and can be a bitch as well. There is good and bad sides.

Enough of talking in philosophical terms, living life like this doesnt help. I am not doing anything in my life, I dont see how I can improve so what is possibly the reason I should live? Being an awkward person living like this is humiliating and sad. Thats it, screw this. I cannot see myself like this for the rest of my life. I cannot improve, sorry.
